يستجهل (form X)
# يَسْتَجْهِلُ (yastajhilu) /jas.tad͡ʒ.hi.lu/: third-person masculine singular non-past active indicative of اِسْتَجْهَلَ (istajhala)
# يُسْتَجْهَلُ (yustajhalu) /jus.tad͡ʒ.ha.lu/: third-person masculine singular non-past passive indicative of اِسْتَجْهَلَ (istajhala)
# يَسْتَجْهِلَ (yastajhila) /jas.tad͡ʒ.hi.la/: third-person masculine singular non-past active subjunctive of اِسْت
